title: Accountable Agents Framework Proposed
content:
X author: @obaid

CAIS and experts including Bruce Schneier, Jonathan Zittrain and Tim O'Reilly released the Accountable Agents framework proposing a directory that verifies agent owners while sites see only pseudonymous IDs, enabling traceability if harm occurs.

Linked sources:
- https://www.accountableagents.ai/

novelty.reason: The release of the Accountable Agents framework proposing an agent owner directory with pseudonymous IDs has not been covered in any previous items.
